_comment: Org-wide settings. Update 'cycle' once per semester; everything else rarely changes.

org.name: NOBE
org.full_name: National Organization for Business and Engineering
org.one_liner: a student business and engineering organization at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
org.overview_attachment: NOBE overview PDF (attach by hand before sending)

consulting.name: Consulting Committee
deliverables: a market-sizing and customer-segment study for a new product line
a go-to-market plan for a new region or customer type
an operations or cost-down review of a specific process
customer discovery interviews with a written findings report
consulting.good_targets: early and growth-stage startups, local small and mid-size businesses, nonprofits, incubator tenants (EnterpriseWorks, Research Park)
consulting.hook_sources: a recent launch, expansion, new market, funding round, hiring push, or a stated growth goal on their site or in the news

tech.name: Tech Committee
deliverables: an internal dashboard that pulls data the team currently tracks by hand
an integration between two tools they already use
a mobile or web feature from their public roadmap or feature-request board
an automation script or small internal tool
a prototype of a customer-facing web app
tech.good_targets: startups and small companies with a small or no engineering team, local businesses running on spreadsheets, nonprofits, software startups with public roadmaps
tech.hook_sources: their product, public docs or API, a job post for an engineering role, a changelog or roadmap, or a visible gap in their site or app

pd.name: Product Development Committee
deliverables: CAD and a 3D-printed prototype of a new part or fixture
a redesign of an existing component for weight or cost
FEA or test validation of a part
a test rig or fixture for their line
design for manufacturing review of a current product
pd.good_targets: hardware startups, robotics, cleantech, agtech, medical devices, local manufacturers, incubator hardware tenants
pd.hook_sources: a specific product, subsystem, or part on their site, a recent prototype or launch, a hardware job post, or a published spec
